name: com.streethawk.library.core.StreethawkBroadcastReceiver
description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. Android starts this receiver at boot, on time-zone changes, and for scheduled StreetHawk status checks. It starts the core service after boot and queues time-zone, heartbeat, and app-status reports.
disableEffect: StreetHawk scheduled status checks, heartbeats, and time-zone reports will stop.
